runtime.description: A topology id from factory/runtimes.json. The catalog is the source; this list is checked against it by factory/tools/seatReturn.mjs.

meterModel.description: The model id the harness meter recorded for the project the lane ran in — the id that actually answered, not the one the launcher was told. A seat cannot see its own model and echoes the envelope's Runtime stamp instead (T69), so the recorder reads this from the usage record and fills it in; it is therefore optional in a return and never required. The two ids agree through the native-to-DashScope map in factory/tools/route.mjs, never by string equality: deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4.1-flash are one model at two vendors (T48). Recording refuses a disagreement, so both ids sit on the stored row and a later price question can see which one was served.

spendUsd.description: Dollars from the meter. Required unless tokens.source names the meter the numbers were pasted from: the usage record carries no cost, so a zero here would be a durable false measurement.

tokens.description: Token counts pasted from the meter: node factory/tools/seatReturn.mjs meter <project-path>.

source.description: The meter the numbers were pasted from, e.g. qwen usage_record.jsonl.

measured.description: What the verify command printed. A word is not output.

cachedTokens.description: prompt_cache_hit_tokens or cached_tokens, pasted from the meter.
